text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through town... I suddenly come to a halt.
I find myself staring intently at the show window.
—Right, it's clothes from that brand.
choice_data_list: (It's been on my mind for a while, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at her reflection in the glass, she gives a slight shake of her head.
She is curious, yes, but... all these high-class designs feel far too mismatched for someone like her――

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to stay and watch?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, forgive me for reaching out out of the blue like this.
That brand is just absolutely gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I love it too, so――I thought we might be kindred spirits, and I just got a little overly excited.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, I've been curious about it, but...
Y-Yeah, I've been wondering about it, but……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She confessed with a self-conscious laugh.
"With my completely average looks and build,
I just don't think I could pull it off"――

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The value of your potential is by no means
something that should be spoken of
in such a manner.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's head inside!
The moment you think, "I want to try wearing that"—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The story meant to make you shine
has already begun!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Denim on denim sounds great, doesn't it?♪ If you're interested, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have the will to shine, clothes will always be right there by your side.
Let me see... for instance—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How about coordinating with a set made of sturdy material?
I think that'll keep it from looking too casual.
choice_data_list: True... I might actually be able to wear this!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, what a wonderful, positive smile!
You're already starting to shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep polishing it more and more!
What kind of challenge would you like to take on next?
choice_data_list: That knit sweater feels oddly comforting...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A flight jacket!
Looking cool in leather—
I totally love that style too♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The patch has such a fun, playful touch too, how lovely!
Shall we try it on right away?
choice_data_list: Alright, time to take the plunge...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to North Flight,
we finished with an utterly satisfying shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A ribbed knit! Those muted tones really do have a calming feel.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: With such a simple design, you have endless outerwear options! My heart races just thinking of the possibilities.
choice_data_list: Alright! I'll show 'em how stylish I can be!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit♪
